candidate_definition: Structural recursion: snoc empty value = cons value empty; snoc (cons head tail) value = cons head (snoc tail value).

counterfactuals.mutation: identity: return the input sequence and ignore the appended value
counterfactuals.result: Rejected by Lean; valSeqLength_snoc and last-element obligations fail.

counterfactuals.mutation: singleton: ignore the input sequence and return only the supplied last value
counterfactuals.result: Rejected by Lean; recursive length and last-element obligations fail.

operational_meaning: The candidate exactly implements the frozen snoc recurrence and therefore preserves every middle element in order and appends the supplied value as the last element. This is the representation required by solution.py's array[-1] and by the frozen vsLen/normIdx/valSeqAt semantics.
